name: image-compare
title: Image Compare
description: An animated image compare slider for React and shadcn, with a divider you drag or move by keyboard.

meta.details: Compare any two layers (screenshots, themes, a plain component and its polished twin) with one divider. A flick coasts to 0, 50 or 100, a slow release stays where it lands, the tags fade as the line passes under them, and the knob is a keyboard slider.

docs: Import ImageCompare from components/eased/image-compare/image-compare. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
